name: DS9 Sim
source:
I'm in the process of making a Star Trek: Deep Space 9 visual novel/dating sim where you can flirt with all your favorite characters and take part in a dramatic plot and possibly fall in love.

[From [url=https://andromedarts.itch.io/ds9sim] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我正在制作一款以《星际迷航：深空九号》为背景的视觉小说／恋爱模拟游戏。你可以和所有喜欢的角色调情，参与戏剧性的剧情，并有机会坠入爱河。

[来源：[url=https://andromedarts.itch.io/ds9sim]itch.io[/url]]
